# Service exit-risk catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_catalog_doc.py from src/exitrisk/data/service_catalog.yaml (version 2026.10). Do not edit by hand. -->

Every AWS service that appears in Cost Explorer is classified into one of five tiers by how much of a workload must change to leave AWS. The tier sets the service's score in the exit-risk calculation; the migration path, equivalents and typical duration are for **one workload** of that service. This is the same content as Appendix A of the generated report.

| Tier | Label | Score | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Portable | 10 | Commodity infrastructure or an open standard. Lift-and-shift; configuration moves, code does not change. |
| 2 | Low | 30 | Managed flavour of an open engine or de-facto standard API. Data and configuration migrate; little code change. |
| 3 | Moderate | 50 | AWS-specific API with a close equivalent on every major cloud. Code changes at the integration points. |
| 4 | High | 75 | Proprietary programming or data model. The workload must be redesigned, not just re-pointed. |
| 5 | Critical | 95 | No equivalent outside AWS. Rebuild, re-platform or replace with a product; often a business change. |

112 services classified. Unknown services score as tier 3 and are flagged on the report's data-quality panel.

## Tier 1 - Portable (27)

| Service | Category | Why this tier | Recommended migration path | Azure | Google Cloud | Cloud-neutral | Typical duration | Eng-weeks / workload |

| **MWAA (Airflow)** | Analytics | Apache Airflow; DAGs are portable apart from AWS operators. | Move DAGs to Cloud Composer, Astronomer or Airflow on Kubernetes; swap AWS operators. | Data Factory Workflow Orchestration Manager / Astronomer | Cloud Composer | Apache Airflow | 2-4 weeks | 1.5 |
| **OpenSearch** | Analytics | Open-source OpenSearch / Elasticsearch APIs (Serverless collections have a reduced API). | Snapshot/restore or reindex into Elastic Cloud, OpenSearch on Kubernetes or Azure AI Search where suitable. | Elastic Cloud on Azure | Elastic Cloud on GCP | OpenSearch | 2-4 weeks | 1.5 |
| **EC2** | Compute | Virtual machines running standard operating systems. Commodity primitives on every cloud. | Recreate volumes and network egress on the target; move data with snapshots or block replication. | **ElastiCache** | Database | Managed Redis / Valkey / Memcached - open engines. | Provision the target cache and warm it; caches rarely need data migration. | Azure Cache for Redis | Memorystore | Redis / Valkey | Days | 0.5 |

## Billing lines excluded from scoring

These are not workloads: Tax (Tax on AWS charges; not a workload.), AWS Support (Support plan fee; replaced by the target provider's support contract.), Savings Plans (Commitment fee rather than a workload. Note the commitment term in the exit plan - it is a cost of leaving early.), Billing tools (Billing tooling; not a workload.)
